cli.usage:
bharbor verifies that your restic backups can really be restored.

Usage:
  bharbor [global options] <command> [options]

Commands:
  init                          Create an example configuration file
  validate [--target NAME]      Check configuration, restic, repositories and passwords (restores nothing)
  run [--target NAME]           Verify backups by restoring them in a private work area
  report [options]              Show or export verification reports
  schedule install|status|remove  Manage the Windows scheduled task
  secret set|delete|status NAME Manage repository passwords in Windows Credential Manager
  help                          Show this help

Global options:
  --config FILE   Configuration file (default: %APPDATA%\BackupHarbor\config.yaml or BACKUPHARBOR_CONFIG)
  --json          Machine-readable JSON output
  --no-color      Disable colour (NO_COLOR is also honoured)
  --lang en|tr    Output language
  --verbose       Print detailed log lines to stderr
  --quiet         Print only errors and the final result
  --version       Print the version
  -h, --help      Show this help

Report options:
  --last              Latest run (default)
  --list              List the report history (--target, --since, --until, --limit)
  --run ID            A specific run
  --target NAME       Only this target
  --format json|html|txt   Output format (default: txt; json with --json)
  --output FILE       Write to a file instead of the console
  --force             Allow replacing an existing output file

Schedule options (install):
  --frequency daily|weekly   --time HH:MM   --day monday..sunday

Exit codes:
  0  every target passed
  1  at least one target failed or was only partly proven
  2  configuration or dependency error, or a target could not be tested
  3  cancelled or timed out
